[[Seaguard Lykaios]] is located in the southeast corner of [[Pongmei Valley]], guarding the entrance to [[Boreas Seabed (outpost)|Boreas Seabed]]. He provides information on what needs doing to gain access.

==Locations==
*[[Kaineng City]]
**{{NPC location|Pongmei Valley}}

==Quests==
'''Quests involved in:'''
*[[Echovald Forest]]
**[[The Convocation]]

==Dialogue==
;before completing [[Arborstone]]
:''"Beyond these gates stretches [[The Jade Sea|the vast Jade Sea]].{{verify|change from vase to vast correct? ANet or gww typo?}} It is an awe-inspiring sight.... Unfortunately, I cannot allow you in to see it. You should journey to Arborstone while [[Master Togo]] is looking for [[Elder Rhea]]. Was there something else you needed?"''

;after completing Arborstone and before accepting The Convocation quest
:''"Beyond these gates stretches the vast Jade Sea. It is an awe-inspiring sight.... Unfortunately, I cannot allow you in to see it. Master Togo informed me that while he is looking for Elder Rhea, <Character Name> should head back to [[Altrumm Ruins]]. Perhaps there is some information to be gained there? Did you need something else?"''

;during The Convocation
:''"Master Togo is somewhere in Pongmei Valley<Character Name>{{sic}} should try to track him down quickly, since The Convocation is almost underway. The sooner you find him, the sooner I can allow you passage into [[Boreas Seabed (outpost)|Boreas Seabed]]. Did you wish to discuss something else?"''

;alternate during The Convocation, objective
:''"It is my duty to guard the entrance to Boreas Seabed. If you have gained approval from the [[Luxon]] Elders, I can arrange transport for you."''

;default
:''"Please continue on through."''

==Notes==
*If you reach Seaguard Lylaios before advancing the plot to Arborstone, he will still falsely tell you to go to Arborstone.
